Cordial Work Environment

Game data v30 · build 254Sources & research notes

News travels fast in the Outlands—maybe too fast. To improve their stories, an independent news outlet in Miguel's Cove is urging workers to maximize their downtime. Ironically, they want this change as quickly as possible.
